selectedColorSemantics.behavior: Maintain one lastSelectedColor in app state and persist it. Entering Modes 4/10 does not change it. Modes 4/10 use recorded frame brightness as a per-LED opacity and the lastSelectedColor as RGB hue.
selectedColorSemantics.fallback: Use existing app current/persisted color; only default to red when no color was ever selected.
selectedColorSemantics.scope: visualization only — BLE commands and timing unchanged

colorBehavior.note: Recorded RGB is only a luminance template; the display color must use lastSelectedColor.
